title: Nib
direction: A marker m cut once by a chisel: one clean angled cut through upright stems, and the cut face is the accent
rationale: markilo means marker in Esperanto; the chisel nib is the literal tool, built from clean angled cuts and one accent tip. Pictorial, ownable, not an icon-library pen.

sketchReview.notes: Keep: m with every stroke end cut at one broad-nib angle, red slice on the right stem as the writing trace; legible at 16 px, 96% score. Fix: stock similarity 61% so push the cut angle and slice proportion harder, make the red a deliberate part of the glyph not a stuck-on block. s5 is the fallback.
